tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background; the reading surface. Text colors ink and ink-muted read on it.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, code blocks and inline code ground. ink, ink-muted and every syn-* color read on it.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, search results, cards and notices. ink, ink-muted and accent read on it.

tokens.name: code-ground
tokens.usage: Inline code in prose: a chip that stands off paper in both themes (lighter than paper in dark). ink and accent read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on paper, paper-sunken, paper-raised and accent-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, paths, captions and placeholders on paper, paper-sunken and paper-raised.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between regions (sidebar edge, table rules). Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and buttons. Not for text: 3:1 against paper, paper-sunken and paper-raised.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, current item, primary button fill, focus ring. Text on paper, paper-sunken, paper-raised and accent-soft.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected tree row and hover on accent surfaces. ink and accent read on it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid with 2px offset, on every surface.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Background of search matches (mark). ink reads on it.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning label and icon on paper and paper-raised. Always paired with the word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error label and icon on paper and paper-raised. Always paired with the word.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success label and icon on paper and paper-raised. Always paired with the word.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Code: keywords, on paper-sunken.

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: Code: strings, on paper-sunken.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Code: numbers and constants, on paper-sunken.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Code: comments, on paper-sunken (italic).

tokens.name: syn-function
tokens.usage: Code: function and method names, on paper-sunken.

tokens.name: syn-type
tokens.usage: Code: types and classes, on paper-sunken.

tokens.name: syn-punct
tokens.usage: Code: punctuation and operators, on paper-sunken.

styles.name: read-body
styles.usage: Rendered document text, in a column of --measure.
styles.sample: Documentation is read, not edited. Keep the page calm.

styles.name: read-lede
styles.usage: First paragraph under a page title.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Default interface text: tree items, buttons, results.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Selected item, button label, result title.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Small labels and counts; sentence case, letter-spaced.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Titles of screens and cards (Resume, unsupported browser).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Fenced code blocks and file paths.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Inline code inside running text; scales with its parent.

styles.name: code-label
styles.usage: Language label on a code block header.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tree item padding, gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, paragraph rhythm.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page gutters on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a page, empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the reading column: about 85 characters at read-body, room for code and tables in technical docs.

tokens.name: measure-wide
tokens.usage: Reading column when the reader chooses Wide: for wide tables and code. Full width removes the limit.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the file tree.

tokens.name: toc
tokens.usage: Width of the page table of contents.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, tree items, search matches.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, notices.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Counts and small tags.

shadow.note: One shadow only. Surfaces are set apart by hairlines, not elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Search results and menus only.
